Language.Text: Order Entry System Designed by Cameyware
Set a logo, header, and footer used on printed receipts and measurement-sheet downloads (separately for each language).
Used for the receipt's tax slip. When set, it is printed directly under the header. The same number is shared by every language, and it is named after whatever the shop's location issues.
Welcome to the Cameyware order management system
Welcome to the Cameyware Order System
Hi {0}, you are logged in as {1}.
Close all order windows before signing out.
Lock this session — your password reopens the same store.
Hides everything until your password is entered. The same store reopens — you are not asked to choose it again.
Ends the session completely. The next person signs in and chooses their own store.
{0} stays open. Enter your password to return to it.
Sign out failed. You are still signed in; try again, and restart the application if it keeps happening.
Take a store out of service, download its data, restore one from a file, or remove it. Ctrl+click to select several; shift+click to select a run.
No stores exist yet. Create one from the Select Shop screen.
A store out of service keeps all of its data and simply stops appearing in Select Shop. Reversible at any time.
A download holds the selected stores, their orders and their settings. Restoring adds them back; a store already present is left untouched.
Restored {0} store(s) and {1} order(s). {2} were already here and were left as they are.
That file is not a store archive.
These cannot be undone. You will be asked to type a phrase to confirm, and offered the chance to save the records first.
Every store's measurement terms and receipt branding
Login accounts, language and global settings are KEPT
There are no stores to remove.
Nothing was deleted: the records could not be saved ({0}).
This cannot be undone. Read what is listed below before continuing.
Type the {0} characters below, exactly as shown, to enable the buttons.
Matches. Both buttons are now enabled.
No shops have been created yet.
No shop is available for your account. Please contact an administrator.
Open a shop to start working. You only see the shops your account is assigned to.
Choose which shops each account may open, and the role it holds in each.
Leave both boxes empty to keep the current password.
Tick the role this account holds in each shop. Ticking both grants both; an account with nothing ticked cannot open that shop.
The administrator has every permission in every shop. The role cannot be changed and the account cannot be deleted.
Work as this person to see the application the way they do. You will be signed out of your own account.
Sign in as {0} ({1})? You will be signed out of your own account, and will need to sign in again to come back.
That account has been deactivated in every shop, so it cannot be signed in to.
What this person types to sign in. Changing it takes effect the next time they sign in.
The administrator's login cannot be changed. That account must stay identifiable and can never be deleted.
Change the login {0} to {1}? This person will sign in with the new one from now on.
No shops have been created yet, so there is nothing to assign.
Select an account on the left to edit it.
Delete the account {0}? This cannot be undone.
That user name is already taken.
The two passwords do not match.
That account is protected and cannot be changed this way.
Your account has been deactivated. Please contact your manager.
Select a member on the left to edit them.
Role and status in this shop
Clearing this delists them from this shop only. They keep access to any other shop they are still active in; if this was their last one, they can no longer sign in.
The hours this person normally works at this shop.
Delete the account for {0}? This removes them from every shop, not just this one, and cannot be undone.
Choose at least one role, or the person is not a member of this shop.
You cannot deactivate your own membership of the shop you are working in.
One name per language. A blank language falls back to a language that has one.
Optional. One address per language; a blank language falls back to a language that has one.
Optional. Phone, email and website are not per language — every language shows the same value.
Optional, and asked for only where the shop's location issues one. Printed on this shop's receipts so they double as a tax slip. A number entered in the header & footer editor overrides this one.
Install at least one language for this shop.
Accept at least one currency for this shop.
Choose which languages this shop runs in and which currencies it takes.
Tick the languages this shop runs in. Each one brings the currencies of its market, and you choose which of those the shop actually takes.
Tick a language on the left to see the currencies it brings.
This language brings no currency of its own.
Configure measurement terms once the shop is open
Enter the shop name in at least one language.
A shop with this name already exists. Choose another name.
These settings apply to this shop only: its name, address and contact details, currency, the tax charged on each payment method, and how its receipts are numbered.
Choose whether each payment method is taxed. These rates apply to every order in this shop.
A tax rate must be a number between 0 and 100.
Prices in this location include tax, so it is shown on the receipt rather than added at the till. It does not vary by payment method, so there is nothing to set per method.

Switching to {0} resets every payment method to that location's starting point and discards the rules configured here. A location that quotes no standard rate — Canada, the United States — starts tax free, so you will need to enter the rate this store collects. Continue?
How a new order (and therefore its receipt) is numbered. Orders that already exist keep their numbers.
Date + a fresh run each day (e.g. ORD-20260727-0001)
Year + a fresh run each year (e.g. ORD-2026-0001)
Close all order windows before switching shops.
The selected file is not a valid measurement terms file.
Database imported (the previous database was automatically backed up)
The selected file is not a valid header & footer settings file.
Importing will overwrite the current measurement terms configuration. Continue?
Importing will replace all current order data and attached document images. This cannot be undone (the current database and images will be automatically backed up). Continue?
Importing will overwrite the current header & footer (including the logo) settings. Continue?

A one-click restore will overwrite the following on this machine: {0}. Your order data and attached images will be replaced (the current database and images are backed up automatically). This cannot be undone. Continue?
Global settings restored; the previous database was backed up automatically
The selected file is not a valid global settings backup package.
Delete order “{0}”? This action cannot be undone.
Delete the {0} selected orders? This action cannot be undone.
These services have items but no charge: {0}. They were settled as-is — please check the price if that was not intended.

These services have items but were not charged (the price is blank or 0): {0}.
Once pick-up is confirmed this order is marked completed and can no longer be modified.
Continue?
{0}: the pre-tax deposit cannot exceed the pre-tax service total. The deposit has been set to {1}.
The date the order was taken. Leave it on today unless you are entering an order from an earlier day.
The day the customer agreed to collect. Required, and it has to be a day still to come.
The order date cannot be later than today.
Please choose the expected pickup date.
The expected pickup date has to be later than today.
Please enter an email address when a payment method is selected.
Please enter a valid email address.

{0}: {1} is not allocated to a payment type.

Please enter the specific cancellation/return reason.

Click Add Item to add clothing or accessory lines.
Please choose a valid image file.
The image file could not be found.
The tax rate is set once for the whole store (Local Config → Shop Settings) and cannot be changed on an individual order.
This order is finalized (completed/shipped/cancelled/returned) and can no longer be edited.
The ready-made categories this shop offers when adding clothing or accessory lines to an order. Each shop keeps its own list.
Restore the predefined categories? Any category you added will be discarded. Existing orders keep the category they were saved with.
Remove “{0}” from this shop's categories? Existing orders keep the category they were saved with.
This shop offers no categories. Add one, or restore the predefined set.
Configure the measurements taken for each garment. Add custom measurements and give them names in other languages.
Drag measurements here from the right
Select a garment on the left
Delete this measurement? It will be removed from every garment.
Restoring defaults will discard this garment's customized measurements. Continue?
This measurement already exists (all language names match) — it cannot be added again.
Please select at least one garment to record measurements.
What the shop took over a period, by service line and by payment method.
No orders were taken in this period.
Define what each role may do, and give people their roles in each shop.
Open an account to see the shops it belongs to, and tick the roles it holds in each.
Open a shop to see the roles, and a role to see what it may do. A role is defined once and means the same thing in every shop.
Delete the role “{0}”? {1} people hold it, and it will be taken from all of them.
Another role already has that name.
Your role does not allow changing orders, so this record is read-only.
See the order list and the details of each record.
Start a new order in this shop.
Change a saved order. Without it the editor opens read-only.
Remove an order, singly or several at once.
Duplicate an existing order into a new one.
Print or save the receipt and the measurement sheet.
Open the report, and see the month's figures on the main screen.
Print the settlement report or save it as a PDF.
Change the shop's details, currency, tax and receipt numbering.
Edit the list of measurements this shop takes.
Edit the letterhead printed on receipts.
Manage who works in this shop, their shift and whether they are active.
Create, edit and rename accounts across the whole installation.
Remove an account outright, from every shop at once.
Define roles and choose what each of them may do.
Add a shop, and reach the store-management tools.
Move the whole installation's data in and out.
Run the application in any shipped language, not only the shop's.
